name: Silk
source:
The first resident of Sweet Wonderland that Alice meets. When he takes a shortcut to class through the campus golf course, Silk leads him through a hole to the Land of Dreams. 
Silk is a cute and quiet rabbit girl, naive in terms of "things between boys and girls". She lives in a house south-east of the Lavinia's castle and has an incredible craving (perhaps "vice" would be the right word) for  carrots, for which she will do unthinkable things. 
Unlike her counterpart (the White Rabbit in Carroll's novel), Silk is never in a hurry... always taking things slowly, unless there is something that interests her, and then all her energy is released.

[Edited from [url=http://blog.pucp.edu.pe/item/15731/eroge-review-alice-parade-parte-i]Iori's review[/url].]
